mapper.select: SELECT tool_version_id AS version_id, version_no, readiness, last_update_time FROM squad_chat.sq_tool_version WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT t.tool_id, t.tool_code, t.tool_name, t.display_alias, t.tool_type, t.latest_version_id, t.latest_version_no, v.exposed_name, v.description, v.read_only FROM squad_chat.sq_tool t JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool_version v ON v.tool_version_id = t.latest_version_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server ms ON ms.mcp_server_id = v.mcp_server_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 'ENABLED' AND t.latest_readiness = 'READY' AND ( t.tool_type != 'MCP' OR (ms.mcp_server_id IS NOT NULL AND ms.deleted_at IS NULL AND ms.status = 'ENABLED' AND ms.latest_readiness = 'READY') ) ORDER BY t.tool_name ASC, t.id ASC
